mapIdentity.scope: The named OSM building way controls the crooked plan. The national designation and Qualla photograph establish the asymmetry, opening types and continuous thatch.

note: Historic Environment Scotland records a single storey, seven entrance bays, five rear bays, whitewashed harled clay walls, reed thatch with deep coping, wooden ridge and rendered stacks.
